query: SELECT pz.purpose, pz.posX, pz.posY, pz.width, pz.height, pp.name as partName FROM product_zones pz JOIN product_parts pp ON pz.partId = pp.id WHERE pp.name LIKE '%Vorder%' OR pp.name LIKE '%Front%' ORDER BY pp.name, pz.purpose;
